prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 75, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 76, 'component': 'Central Metrics Pipeline', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 77, 'component': 'Client Error Reporting SDK', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 78, 'component': 'Passwordless Auth Service', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 79, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 80, 'component': 'File Storage Service', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 81, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 82, 'component': 'Queue Manager', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 83, 'component': 'Backup & Restore Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 84, 'component': 'Region Failover Controller', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 85, 'component': 'Global API Gateway', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 86, 'component': 'Circuit Breaker', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 87, 'component': 'DNS Resolution Service', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 88, 'component': 'Report Scheduler', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 89, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}]

response: {"incidents": [{"i": 75, "summary": "SSO Broker outage in US-East persisted for 3 hours, blocking user authentication across the region."}, {"i": 76, "summary": "Central Metrics Pipeline crashed in US-West for an hour, causing a blackout in monitoring dashboards."}, {"i": 77, "summary": "Client Error Reporting SDK failed across LATAM, preventing error logs from being sent to backend."}, {"i": 78, "summary": "Passwordless Auth Service degradation in US-East lasted one hour, affecting major login paths."}, {"i": 79, "summary": "Social Login Connector outage was global and lasted 2 hours, preventing users from signing in via social providers."}, {"i": 80, "summary": "File Storage Service went offline in ME for 2 hours, blocking file uploads and downloads."}, {"i": 81, "summary": "Central Message Queue failure in ME for 30 minutes halted asynchronous processing."}, {"i": 82, "summary": "Queue Manager issues in ME lasted 30 minutes, impacting message routing."}, {"i": 83, "summary": "Backup & Restore Service experienced a brief global outage (30 mins), pausing scheduled backups."}, {"i": 84, "summary": "Region Failover Controller in US-East was unstable for 5 hours, delaying disaster recovery operations."}, {"i": 85, "summary": "Global API Gateway had a 30-minute major incident in US-East, causing intermittent API failures."}, {"i": 86, "summary": "Circuit Breaker misconfiguration in ME lasted 2 hours, incorrectly blocking traffic to downstream services."}, {"i": 87, "summary": "DNS Resolution Service outage in APAC for 1 hour led to widespread connectivity issues for users in the region."}, {"i": 88, "summary": "Report Scheduler failed in EU-West for 60 minutes, preventing scheduled reports from being generated."}, {"i": 89, "summary": "Duplicate alert for Central Message Queue failure in ME (30 mins duration)."}]}
